q: What grid emission factor should a supplier in Serbia use?
title: Serbia grid factor for suppliers
short: Serbia's power comes mostly from lignite, with hydro making up most of the rest, so its grid factor is high, roughly 0.7 kg CO2 per kWh or a little above. Use the official or IEA figure for the reporting year and name it.
audience: Auto parts, steel and food suppliers in Serbia reporting Scope 2 to EU buyers

ul: Location based: national average for the year.
Market based: guarantees of origin for hydro or wind, if you buy them.

p: EU customers compare suppliers. A lignite grid can double a factory's footprint against a supplier on a cleaner grid.
Rooftop solar and renewable contracts cut market based Scope 2. Keep meter data and certificates.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills into dated, fingerprinted records and keeps location based and market based figures side by side, each with the factor and year used.
